sources_used.source: Bing Maps business listings (opened in browser as a visitor, multiple category queries)
Web search with category + town queries (surfaced directory and company pages)
NJ Schools Development Authority vendor listing

categories_thin: Law: only 3 South Plainfield offices surfaced. Most legal directories (Justia, FindLaw, Martindale, Avvo, Lawyers.com) blocked automated access, and Bing Maps showed just one attorney for the town, so the true count is likely higher.
Accounting: CPAdirectory lists only 3 firms in town; other firms appear only in YellowPages/Superpages data that could not be opened directly.
Insurance: only 5 agencies found. Several South Plainfield agencies are branded carrier franchises (State Farm, Allstate, Progressive) and were excluded per the brief, which thins this category.
Fitness: very thin - Planet Fitness and LA Fitness are chains and were excluded; only one martial arts studio, one CrossFit box and dance/yoga studios remain.

Architects, surveyors, environmental and staffing: South Plainfield has large office parks (Cragwood Rd, Corporate Blvd, Hadley Rd, Durham Ave) whose tenants are poorly covered by free directories, so this is almost certainly undercounted.
caveats: Many group A entries come from YellowPages/Superpages/D&B data surfaced by search but not directly openable (those sites returned HTTP 403 / Cloudflare blocks); they are marked 'one directory only' or 'bulk directory' in active_evidence and need confirmation by the triage team.

Excluded as chains/franchises per the brief: Diamond Braces, Great Clips, Planet Fitness, LA Fitness, Kessler Rehabilitation, JAG Physical Therapy, Twin Boro Physical Therapy, SportsCare Physical Therapy, Professional Physical Therapy, BEST Physical Therapy, AFC Urgent Care, H&R Block, Randstad, Adecco, Aerotek, Spherion, Terracon Consultants, America's Best Contacts & Eyeglasses, and the State Farm agency at 430 Hamilton Blvd.

Excluded as bank/health-system owned: TD Wealth advisors, Wells Fargo Advisors, J.P. Morgan Wealth Management, Citizens Wealth Management (all bank-based) and Atlantic Medical Group Cardiology (Atlantic Health System).
Some entries are single practitioners (one physician, one optometrist, one architect) rather than firms; they are listed because they are independent local practices at a South Plainfield address.
Where two listings gave different phones or addresses for the same practice, both are noted in the notes field rather than choosing silently.

Google Maps was only usable in a 5-result 'limited view' without signing in, so Bing Maps was used for map coverage; Bing's coverage of professional-services offices is weaker than its coverage of retail/health clinics.
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap Overpass API (all mirrors tried) and the raw OSM map endpoint were unusable for POI extraction; no OSM-based business list was produced.

Blocked to this environment (HTTP 403/429 or Cloudflare challenge): YellowPages, Superpages, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com, BBB, Cylex, Opendi, AllPages, FindOpen, WhereOrg, Yelp, Justia, FindLaw, Avvo, Lawyers.com, MapQuest listings, Bizapedia.

No South Plainfield borough business directory, economic-development business list, or local chamber of commerce member directory was reachable; if one exists it would improve completeness for the office parks.

NJ Division of Revenue business-entity search and licensed-professional lookups (CPA, law, insurance producer, engineering) were not used; cross-checking registrations would confirm the directory-only entries.
Websites were recorded only where a company domain appeared in a listing or was opened; roughly half the entries have no website recorded and are left blank for the triage team.
No attempt was made to identify home-based businesses that do not appear in any directory.
